# `jouet diag delta`

- **Usage:** `jouet diag delta [--changed] [--max <N>] [FILES]…`

Report only the findings an edit introduced

Checks the files, then compares each with the last check of an earlier version of it: a finding is the same one when its file, rule and step match and its message matches or it is within three lines, so findings that only moved are not new. A file unchanged since HEAD has nothing new. A changed file no check has seen before has no baseline; its findings are listed apart and not counted. Exits 1 when the edit introduced a finding or made a step without diagnostics fail.

## Arguments
- **`[FILES]…`** — Files to check (default: --changed)

## Flags
- **`--changed`** — The files that differ from HEAD or are untracked
- **`--max <N>`** — Show at most N findings (default 50); the rest are counted
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
